items.question: On the S25/Pocket4P, does the connectedDevice host preserve truthful session/transfer state through background/screen-off and recover a controlled AP/session loss only after source revalidation?
items.why_hardware: Android foreground-service policy, Pocket AP/BLE/datalink behavior and firmware-specific liveness cannot be established by synthetic emulation.
software_evidence: post-connect empty-inventory bounded-retry JVM regression PASS

software_closure_build.internal_validation: 481 JVM tests, zero failures/errors; safe-current dispatch, service-owned paginated aggregation and empty/partial-source refusal

items.observation: Install the signer-compatible closure APK in place without clearing data. Verify automatic known-camera connect and trusted non-empty inventory without Rescan. With the existing `download=2` candidates, observe service-owned strict download start without pressing Download; Camera Sync/Redundancy must remain pending and Safe to Clear no while historical identity ambiguity remains. Then background/screen-off separately and controlled AP/session loss, observe bounded rebuild/revalidation and retained partial. Do not delete, reset, or re-download protected originals.

criteria.PASS: Service truth remains accurate; recovery is bounded; no duplicate writer/false completion; incomplete enumeration stays untrusted and partial remains preserved.
criteria.FAIL: Activity loss stops/duplicates work, stale result mutates a replacement, false completion occurs, or recovery bypasses source revalidation.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Required phone/camera state, consent, or source enumeration is unavailable; preserve safe state and record reason.

items.engineering_decision: Qualify physical liveness/recovery claims or retain hardware-pending status; never enable unsafe resume/deletion.
items.new_hypothesis: The service-owned fenced runtime survives UI lifecycle changes and fails closed on real transport loss.
items.latest_attempt: 2026-09-18 prior artifact: normal restart auto-connected and restored six-item grid; background/screen-off/foreground preserved session. Controlled Pocket power-cycle then stopped CameraConnectionService with no automatic rebuild. One permitted Rescan showed 1/1 saved camera in range but did not auto-select; manual selection restored grid. Plan stayed complete=false/download=2/verify=3/revalidate=1/review=0, with no transfer. Repair build now preserves host on unexpected live-grid GATT loss, performs at most three fenced recovery scans, closes scan-timeout selection race, and exposes privacy-safe plan completeness counts. Retest the entire chain with the new build; no destructive action occurred.

items.question: Can real AP loss, camera-unavailable state and foreground session drop be distinguished into accurate user-action/recovery reason states without credential or source-content logging?
items.why_hardware: The target radio/protocol symptoms and Android callbacks require the exact S25/Pocket4P pair.
prerequisites: No camera setting changes unless separately authorized
items.observation: During the same controlled loss/recovery session, record reason-coded state transitions and verify no credentials, GPS, paths or media content enter diagnostics.

criteria.PASS: Observed states are truthful, bounded and sanitized; unavailable hardware presents USER_ACTION_REQUIRED rather than a speculative cause.
criteria.FAIL: Incorrectly inferred credential/source state, unsafe automatic continuation, or sensitive diagnostic output.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Symptom cannot be safely induced or classified; retain UNKNOWN and no stronger claim.

items.engineering_decision: Tune only evidence-backed adapter reasons; keep UNKNOWN and fail-closed behavior otherwise.
items.new_hypothesis: The fenced state machine preserves uncertainty while exposing actionable physical reasons.

items.question: Can the S25 persist and later reacquire read/write SAF access to the approved USB SSD through the target hub, automatically detect its reappearance independently of Pocket connection, and correctly report unavailable, revoked or insufficient-capacity storage?
items.why_hardware: Real USB host power, hub enumeration, filesystem/provider behavior and Android permission lifecycle cannot be established by an emulator or fake provider.
software_evidence: capture-day SAF allocation and collision refusal tests
prerequisites: Use a disposable SSD test directory
Record no paths/media names in exported diagnostics
items.observation: Select an empty SSD directory once, detach the Pocket, disconnect/reconnect the SSD and hub, then observe automatic availability/permission state before and after app restart. Do not select a new tree or overwrite existing files.

criteria.PASS: Configured destination identity is reacquired only with valid grant/access and the app detects reappearance without a Pocket session; absence, revocation or low capacity remains unavailable/user-action-required.
criteria.FAIL: A stale destination is treated as writable, a grant is bypassed, camera absence blocks SSD detection, or unrelated content is overwritten.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Hub/SSD/permission UI is unavailable; preserve destination state and record no stronger claim.

items.engineering_decision: Qualify target-host/SAF assumptions only; never count SSD redundancy without separate verified replica evidence.
items.deferred_reason: The intended USB dongle/hub currently provides no usable SSD validation path with either the S25 or PC. This is not an Osmosis, SAF, or SSD failure claim.

items.question: Does a real phone-to-SSD copy retain partial state on disconnect/process restart, avoid duplicate final allocation, and become verified only after independent readback checksum?
items.why_hardware: Provider rename/write durability, physical cable removal and real S25/SSD I/O failure modes require the target configuration.
prerequisites: One newly created non-sensitive test asset
items.observation: Replicate a verified phone test asset, induce one controlled SSD removal during a second copy, restart once, reconnect, and inspect ledger/UI state plus final checksum only.

criteria.PASS: Completed replica checksum matches phone proof; interrupted copy stays PARTIAL/review-required and does not duplicate or count toward redundancy.
criteria.FAIL: Partial/final confusion, duplicate allocation, checksum mismatch promoted, or camera sync truth is damaged by SSD loss.
criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: Safe interruption cannot be induced; retain PARTIAL/unknown behavior and record reason.

items.engineering_decision: Qualify real external-replica recovery or retain hardware-pending status; no cleanup eligibility follows automatically.
items.deferred_reason: The intended USB dongle/hub currently provides no usable SSD validation path with either the S25 or PC. This is not an Osmosis, SAF, or SSD failure claim.
